items.title: Camara reflects on 'very special' F1 weekend debut

summaries.en: Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur confirms discussions with Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc following the Mexico GP. Vasseur emphasizes Ferrari's priority of prioritizing Hamilton and Leclerc. Toto Wolff, Mercedes CEO, weighs in on the situation. items.title: Komatsu on why fast-tracking Camara was a ‘tough decision’
items.content: Rafael Camara has been given an earlier-than-expected debut at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix – but Haas Team Principal Ayao Komatsu has conceded that the decision was not a straightforward one.
items.contentSnippet: Rafael Camara has been given an earlier-than-expected debut at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix – but Haas Team Principal Ayao Komatsu has conceded that the decision was not a straightforward one.

summaries.zh: 科马斯特承认，让卡马拉提前亮相圣保罗大奖赛是“艰难的决定”。尽管卡马拉获得了比预期更早的出场机会，但哈斯车队领队表示，这一决策并非易事。
summaries.en: Haas Team Principal Ayao Komatsu acknowledges the "tough decision" of fast-tracking Rafael Camara for an earlier-than-expected debut at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. The choice was not straightforward, reflecting the complexity behind the move.
